summary: Listino ↔ WorkTypes + Invoice auto-sum from linked ISSUED declaration fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 62/62 pytest passing (56 previously-green regression + 6 new tests in test_listino_link.py). New feature tests: (1) POST /api/price-items round-trips category + subtype via POST and PUT and GET returns them; (2) POST /api/price-items/generate creates exactly one price item per (category, subtype) from the seeded work-types catalog (8 items total for the 2 defaults: Protesi Fissa 4 subtypes + Protesi Provvisoria 4 subtypes), each with mode='per_element', price=0, name==subtype, category and subtype populated; (3) idempotency — second POST /api/price-items/generate returns {created:0} and total items unchanged; (4) auth guard (401/403 without token); (5) full linked-declaration invoice flow: created an ISSUED declaration with 2 works (Protesi Fissa/Corona in Zirconia Monolitica on tooth 13 AND Protesi Provvisoria/Provvisorio on tooth 13), matched each work to its listino entry by subtype (Corona=120, Provvisorio=50), built two lines qty=1 (per_element × 1 tooth) and POSTed /api/invoices — server-computed total is exactly 170.00; both lines persist with declaration_id set and are returned by GET /api/invoices/{id}; (6) fallback: subtype without any listino match yields unit_price=0 and total 0. Frontend at mobile 390×844 with tecnico@lab.it: Profilo → Fatturazione → Listino tab shows the new 'Genera dal catalogo lavorazioni' button (generate-price-items). Tapping it seeded 8 items each displayed as 'Per elemento · Protesi Fissa › Corona in Zirconia Monolitica' etc. (correct category › subtype format), all at €0,00. Editing an item opens the FormSheet where category chips (price-category-<workTypeId>) and subtype chips (price-subtype-<name>) are rendered; the subtype chip auto-fills the name field; saving a new price (120, 50) persists and appears immediately. New invoice: after selecting client 'TEST UI LinkClient', the 'Collega dichiarazioni' section lists ONLY the ISSUED declaration (the DRAFT declaration for the same client is correctly filtered out). Tapping link-decl-<id> adds exactly TWO lines — line 0 desc='Protesi Fissa — Corona in Zirconia Monolitica' qty=1 price=120, line 1 desc='Protesi Provvisoria — Provvisorio' qty=1 price=50 — and the live footer total shows € 170,00. Tapping link-decl-<id> again unlinks: both lines are removed (0 remaining). Re-linking and tapping 'Crea fattura' persists the invoice; detail screen shows FT-2026-0001, cliente 'TEST UI LinkClient', total € 170,00, both lines with 'per elemento' badges. preview-invoice-button renders the Fattura PDF containing both descriptions with Q.tà 1 × € 120,00 and 1 × € 50,00 → Imponibile € 170,00 → Totale € 170,00. All requested testIDs are wired correctly. No console errors during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py generate_price_items (line 595): idempotency key uses lowercase(category) + lowercase(subtype). Correct in current tests but the user's manually-entered price items with same subtype but slightly different casing/whitespace (e.g. trailing space) would be treated as different — trim() would harden this. Minor.

frontend billing/new.tsx toggleDeclarationLine (line 79-98): if a work has teeth=[] the qty falls back to 1 for per_element mode. This is a UX safety net, but a subtle divergence from the stated 'always per element' rule. Acceptable, since a work with 0 teeth is invalid anyway; consider surfacing a hint to the user.

frontend billing/new.tsx line 71: total is still computed as `subtotal + (bollo ? 2 : 0)` hard-coded to 2, while backend uses invoice.bollo_amount (default 2). If bollo_amount is ever customized the UI preview will diverge from server total. Same minor point as iteration 7.

frontend billing/index.tsx onFab (line 128): single FAB whose behavior depends on active tab. Works, but two dedicated testIDs (add-invoice-fab / add-price-fab) would harden tests. Same minor point as iteration 7.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Listino generate + category/subtype chips; new invoice draft-filter + auto-sum 170,00 across 2 works; unlink removes both; detail + PDF render both lines)

seed_data_creation: During UI test: upserted listino prices Corona=120 & Provvisorio=50, created client 'TEST UI LinkClient', one ISSUED declaration with 2 works (tooth 13) and one DRAFT declaration, and one invoice FT-2026-0001. All cleaned up via API at the end of the run.

Endpoints for the new feature: POST /api/price-items/generate returns {created:n} (idempotent by category+subtype, seeds per_element items at price 0); PriceItem/PriceItemInput now include category and subtype (both round-trip via POST/PUT/GET). Frontend key testIDs — Listino tab: generate-price-items, price-category-<workTypeId>, price-subtype-<subtypeName>, price-mode-flat, price-mode-element, price-value-input, price-save-button, price-item-<id>, delete-price-<id>. Linking logic in /app/frontend/app/billing/new.tsx toggleDeclarationLine (line 79): iterates decl.works, matches listino by subtype (case-insensitive) then by category (with empty subtype), qty=teeth.length for per_element mode (fallback 1 if 0 teeth), unit_price from matched listino (0 if none), declaration_id set on every generated line — so unlinking removes ALL lines with that declaration_id at once. Server-side invoice_total = Σ(qty × unit_price) + (bollo ? bollo_amount : 0).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The four code-review notes above are polish / robustness suggestions, not correctness blockers.
